content: This document specifies the functional and non-functional requirements for the Authentication Service, which provides user authentication, session management, and token issuance for client applications (web and mobile) accessing the platform via the API Gateway.

The Authentication Service is composed of an AuthController, a TokenService, a PasswordHasher, and a SessionManager, fronted by a Rate Limiter and Request Router at the API Gateway layer. User records are persisted in UserDB; session state is persisted in SessionStore; authentication events are persisted in AuditDB.

FR-AUTH-001: The system shall authenticate users via POST /auth/login using an email address and password.
FR-AUTH-002: The system shall return HTTP 401 Unauthorized when the submitted credentials are invalid.
FR-AUTH-003: The system shall require a time-based one-time password (TOTP) code to complete authentication when multi-factor authentication (MFA) is enabled for the user account.

FR-AUTH-004: The system shall issue an access token and a refresh token upon successful authentication.
FR-AUTH-005: The system shall allow a client to obtain a new access token via POST /auth/refresh using a valid, non-expired refresh token.
FR-AUTH-006: The system shall invalidate a user's active session upon logout via POST /auth/logout.

FR-AUTH-007: The system shall lock a user account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts.
FR-AUTH-008: The system shall automatically unlock a locked account after 15 minutes.
FR-AUTH-009: The system shall rate-limit login attempts to 10 requests per minute per client IP address.
FR-AUTH-010: The system shall record an audit log entry for every login success, login failure, and logout event.

NFR-AUTH-001: All client-server communication shall use TLS 1.2 or higher.
NFR-AUTH-002: Access tokens shall be signed using the RS256 asymmetric algorithm.
NFR-AUTH-003: Access tokens shall expire 15 minutes after issuance.
NFR-AUTH-004: User passwords shall be a minimum of 12 characters and shall contain uppercase, lowercase, numeric, and symbol characters.
NFR-AUTH-005: Audit log records shall be retained for a minimum of 90 days.

Registered User: an authenticated end user of the client application.
Unauthenticated Client: a caller that has not yet completed authentication.
